aboutPage.metaTitle: About Santura Engineering | Refractory Anchor Manufacturer Since 1980
aboutPage.metaDescription: Santura Engineering, Mumbai: founded in 1980 by Bharat Diwan, refractory anchors since 2005, ISO 9001:2015 certified, exporting to 25+ countries.
aboutPage.intro: A Mumbai manufacturer of refractory anchors, stud anchors and stainless steel fibres, founded in 1980 and exporting to more than 25 countries.
story: The business was founded in Mumbai in 1980 by Mr. Bharat Diwan, a production engineer. It began as an engineering and fabrication workshop serving local industry.

In 2005 the company started manufacturing refractory anchors, and in 2008 it was incorporated as Santura Engineering Pvt. Ltd. Today it makes the full SEPL range of anchors for brick, castable, double and ceramic fibre linings, together with washers and stainless steel fibres, and supplies refractory contractors and plant operators in India and abroad.

privacyPage.metaDescription: How Santura Engineering Pvt. Ltd. collects and uses data from its contact, RFQ and newsletter forms, Google Analytics and cookies.
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains what personal data Santura Engineering Pvt. Ltd. collects through this website, why we collect it and what rights you have.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
body: Santura Engineering Pvt. Ltd. (CIN U74200MH2008PTC184443), BPT Plot No. 200, 201, Quay Street, Darukhana, Reay Road, Mumbai 400010, India, is responsible for the personal data described in this policy. You can contact us at enquiries@santura-eng.com.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
body: Contact form: your name, email address, company, country and message.
Request for quotation (RFQ) form: your name, email address, phone number, company, country, and the product and project details you send.
Newsletter: your email address, the language of the page and the page where you signed up.

Analytics: when you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics 4 records the pages you visit, how long you stay, the referring site, your device and browser type and your approximate location. We do not use this to identify you.
Communications: emails and WhatsApp messages you send us directly.

sections.title: 3. How we use your data
body: We use your data to answer enquiries, prepare quotations, carry out and follow up orders, send our newsletter if you subscribed, understand how the website is used so we can improve it, and meet our legal and accounting obligations. We do not sell your data and do not use it for automated decision-making.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
body: For visitors in the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom: we handle enquiries and RFQs as steps taken at your request before a contract and in our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries; newsletter emails and analytics cookies are based on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time; records kept for tax and accounting are a legal obligation. For visitors in India, we process data in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
body: Essential: a language cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers the language you chose. It does not track you.
Analytics: Google Analytics 4 sets cookies such as _ga to count visits and measure use of the site. These are set only if you accept them.
Maps: the map on our contact page is provided by Google Maps, which may set its own cookies when the map loads.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking analytics cookies does not affect how the site works.

sections.title: 6. Who we share data with
body: We share data only with service providers that run the website for us: Supabase (form database), Vercel (website hosting) and Google (analytics and maps). They process data on our instructions. We may also disclose data where the law requires it, for example to tax authorities or courts.

sections.title: 7. International transfers
body: Our service providers may store data outside your country, including in the United States and the European Union. Where data from the EEA or UK is transferred, it is protected by the providers’ contractual safeguards, such as the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: 8. How long we keep data
body: Enquiries and RFQs are kept for as long as needed to handle them and maintain our business relationship, and for any longer period required by tax or commercial law. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe. Analytics data is kept according to our Google Analytics retention settings.

sections.title: 9. Security
body: Form data is sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and stored in a database with access controls. Public website visitors can submit forms but cannot read stored submissions.

sections.title: 10. Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, object to or restrict its use, receive a copy of it, and withdraw consent at any time. To unsubscribe from the newsletter, use the link in any newsletter email or write to us. To exercise any right, email enquiries@santura-eng.com. You may also complain to the data protection authority in your country.

sections.title: 11. Children
body: This website is intended for businesses and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy when our website or the law changes. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.

sections.title: 1. Technical data is for reference only
body: Product descriptions, dimensions, alloy grades, maximum service temperatures, anchor spacing figures and other technical data on this website are typical values for general guidance. They are not a specification or a guarantee of performance. The specifications that apply to your order are those confirmed in the approved drawing, our order acknowledgement and the test certificates supplied with the goods.

sections.title: 2. Selection and suitability
body: The choice of anchor type, alloy, spacing and installation method depends on the lining design, operating conditions and refractory material. It remains the responsibility of the purchaser and its engineers. Where we give recommendations, they are based on the information supplied to us.

sections.title: 3. Pricing and quotations
body: This website does not publish prices. Prices are given only in written quotations, which are valid for the period stated and may change with raw material costs, exchange rates, quantities and delivery terms.

sections.title: 4. Availability and lead times
body: Products, alloys and sizes shown are subject to availability. Lead times and transit times are estimates and are confirmed at the time of order. Products marked “Coming Soon” are not yet available.

sections.title: 5. Images and drawings

sections.title: 6. Industry and company names

sections.title: 8. External links

sections.title: 9. Limitation of liability
